scene_cards.dramatic_function: To trigger the core conflict by revealing Derry's death inside the prematurely opened kiln.
required_beats: Arthur overrides Maren's cooling schedule and forces an immediate opening of Kiln 4.
Maren uses her interlock key to unlock the wicket door.
Orson pulls out the kiln car to reveal Derry dead among the saggers.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To place Maren directly under suspicion while surfacing the first anomalous clue.
required_beats: Arthur confronts Maren with negligence charges and confiscates her brass interlock key.
Maren notices coarse purple twine used to repair a coat sleeve on the office peg.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To uncover physical evidence indicating intentional tampering with the kiln ventilation.
required_beats: Maren and Orson inspect the outer wall of Kiln 4 as Orson grumbles about Derry loafing near the exhaust.
Maren discovers the overhead draft damper wedged open with scrap rebar.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To reveal the institutional conspiracy aligning against Maren and highlight her vulnerability.
required_beats: Tessa warns Maren that management and insurers are preparing to scapegoat her over contract liability.
Maren confesses that severe exhaustion left her memory of the critical shift hours completely blank.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To uncover physical discrepancies in the batch house and establish Nora's evasiveness regarding Derry's timeline.
required_beats: Maren presses Nora for Derry's mixing chits from earlier in the night.
Nora nervously evades Maren and claims Derry departed before 02:30.
Maren discovers that the balance scale's two-pound brass counterweight is missing.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To turn the suspicion directly onto Maren and destabilize her trust in her own memory.
required_beats: Maren questions Orson about the exact timing of the wicket bar closure.
Orson claims he witnessed Maren at the lock bar in her yellow oilskin coat at 03:45.
Maren realizes she lacks an alibi for that hour and questions her own sanity.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To reveal physical evidence tying Bram to recent illicit electrical work despite his hostility.
required_beats: Maren searches Bram's pegboard for spare wicket keys or lock picks.
Bram angrily orders her to leave while claiming he was rebuilding a slip pump.
Maren spots fresh, blistering arc burns on Bram's forearms and wrists.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To confront Maren with seemingly undeniable written proof of her complicity in the shift's events.
required_beats: Arthur presents the shift firing ledger on his desk to Maren.
Arthur points out Maren's distinctive cursive initials marking the 04:00 gas valve check.
Maren recognizes her own handwriting and struggles to understand how or when she made it.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Exposes Arthur's deliberate cover-up of the kiln's overnight pressure failure.
required_beats: Maren enters the weighbridge booth to inspect the pipeline manometer tapes.
Maren catches Nora transcribing data to conceal a major pressure drop at 03:10.
Nora admits that Arthur commanded her to erase the incident from the records.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Isolates Maren as the union turns on her to shield the crew from blame.
required_beats: Tessa gathers the shift workers at Kiln 4 under the guise of reviewing safety protocols.
Orson publicly accuses Maren of standing by the padlock bar when Derry disappeared.
Tessa informs Maren that the union will protect the workforce rather than defend her.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Frames Maren conclusively in front of the union by planting incriminating evidence in her possession.
required_beats: Arthur brings the police liaison and yard committee to Maren's office to search her locker.
Confident in her innocence, Maren unlocks her locker for Arthur.
Arthur uncovers Derry's soot-stained rag hiding the missing scale counterweight.
Tessa abandons Maren to management's custody.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Breaks Arthur's frame-up by revealing a critical flaw in his fabricated timeline.
required_beats: Arthur pressures an exhausted Maren to confess to manslaughter using the planted evidence.
Nora brings the sanitized ledger into the office for Arthur's signature.
Maren spots that the 03:10 gas failure makes Arthur's 04:00 firing timeline impossible.
Arthur falters while attempting to reconcile the discrepancy, exposing his fabrication.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Dismantles the eyewitness claim tying Maren to the lock bar and uncovers a key physical clue.
required_beats: Maren uses the slip agitator steam at the wicket to show Orson could not have recognized her face.
Orson admits he only saw a yellow oilskin coat at the lock bar.
Orson reveals the coat sleeves had distinctive purple mending thread at the cuffs.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Exposes Bram's theft of the key and uncovers Arthur's illegal payoff to Derry.
required_beats: Maren identifies the purple twine cuffs on Bram's slicker in the repair shop.
Bram confesses to stealing Maren's master key while she was asleep.
Arthur tries to silence Bram, but Maren links Bram's forearm burns to the high-voltage burner electrodes.
Bram admits Arthur paid Derry to crawl inside the hot muffle flue to repair a broken baffle.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Reveals the fatal mechanism of Derry's death and demonstrates Arthur's direct culpability.
required_beats: Maren brings Tessa and Arthur to the rebar wedge holding the high roof damper open.
Maren explains that the open damper served as Derry's only breathing line inside the flue.
Maren proves Arthur triggered the automated firing cycle from his office, suffocating Derry and framing her.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: Brings Arthur to justice at the cost of shutting down the town's industrial lifeblood.
required_beats: Maren gives the police the manometer logs and Bram's signed witness statement.
Arthur is arrested for manslaughter while issuing a parting warning about the town's ruin.
The board orders an immediate and indefinite lockout of the works.

scene_cards.dramatic_function: To demonstrate the pyrrhic cost of Maren's victory as she is cast out by the very community she revealed the truth to.
required_beats: Receivers chain the gates and shut down the last operational kilns.
Orson and the assembled workers turn their backs in ostracism as Maren departs.
Tessa warns Maren that uncovering the truth has rendered her unemployable across the entire port.

metadata.title: The Cold Muffle
metadata.source: segmented from a Fabula-only package by gemini-3.8-flash

premise.logline: A glaze factory kiln is opened a day early and a worker is found inside, and the shift supervisor who holds the only key has to account for a night she cannot remember clearly.

modules.theme: how a workplace decides in advance who will be blamed
modules.setting_time: a winter of short shifts and a failing order book
modules.setting_place: a glaze works on the edge of a port town
modules.protagonist: the night shift supervisor, recently promoted from the floor
modules.protagonist_want: to reconstruct a night she spent too tired to remember properly
modules.antagonism: a management that has already chosen its account of events
modules.complication: her own reconstruction keeps producing a version that convicts her
modules.ending_shape: the truth is established and costs the person who established it

plot_shape.name: Mystery
plot_shape.central_question: What actually happened, and who is willing to say so?

phases.name: Disturbance
phases.purpose: A wrong surfaces and someone is obliged to look into it.

phases.name: Inquiry
phases.purpose: Evidence accumulates, most of it true and misread.

phases.name: Wrong turn
phases.purpose: A reading of the evidence that is coherent and wrong collapses.

phases.name: Solution
phases.purpose: The true account, assembled only from what the reader has already been shown.

phases.name: Cost
phases.purpose: What knowing costs the person who found out.

cast_roles.purpose: Carries the reader through the inquiry and pays its cost.
Has a reason to keep the true account from being assembled.
Holds one true piece and misunderstands its meaning.
The reason the question matters at all.

obligatory_moves: Every element of the true account is on the page before it is stated.
At least one true detail is shown early in a context that makes it look irrelevant.
The wrong reading is defensible on the evidence available when it is made.

events.summary: Arthur demands Kiln 4 be opened early to check an anomalous heat loss, and Derry's body is discovered on the kiln car tracks.
events.dramatic_function: Disturbance: the inciting crime is discovered, instantly putting the protagonist in the crosshairs of management.
beats: Arthur overrules Maren's cooling schedule and insists on unsealing Kiln 4 immediately.
Maren uses her master interlock key to unlock the wicket door padlock.
Orson rolls out the forward kiln car and finds Derry dead inside among the saggers.

events.summary: Arthur corners Maren in her office to seize her key and logbook while Maren notices purple twine mending a coat on the peg.
events.dramatic_function: Disturbance / Setup: establishes Arthur's aggressive blame campaign and plants the repaired coat cuffs during the confrontation.
beats: Arthur accuses Maren of criminal negligence since only her key could seal the wicket.
Arthur seizes the brass interlock key from Maren's desk.
Maren notices someone has stitched torn sleeve cuffs on a wall coat using coarse purple nylon twine.

events.summary: Maren checks the kiln exterior with Orson and notices an iron rebar wedge holding the high roof draft damper open.
events.dramatic_function: Disturbance / Plant: introduces physical evidence of ventilation tampering while disguised as general shift disorder.
beats: Maren retraces her perimeter rounds along the Kiln 4 outer muffle wall.
Orson complains that Derry had been loafing near the exhaust stacks during the shift.
Maren spots the high overhead roof exhaust damper jammed open with a scrap piece of rebar.

events.summary: Tessa warns Maren that management is drafting an incident report pinning Derry's death entirely on supervisor fatigue.
events.dramatic_function: Disturbance / Escalation: reveals the institutional stakes and confirms that the factory has chosen its scapegoat.
beats: Tessa enters the office to report that Arthur has already called the firm's marine insurers.
Tessa explains the naval contract penalties make an accident verdict financially fatal for the owners.
Maren admits her recollection between 03:00 and 05:00 is completely blank from three days of double shifts.

events.summary: Maren searches the raw materials station for Derry's batch receipts and discovers a two-pound counterweight is missing.
events.dramatic_function: Inquiry / Plant: begins Maren's active timeline investigation and plants the missing weight.
beats: Maren presses Nora for Derry's mixing chits from the first half of the night.
Nora nervously evades eye contact and insists Derry left the batch house before 02:30.
Maren notices the mechanical balance scale is missing its two-pound brass counterweight.

events.summary: Orson tells Maren he saw her at the Kiln 4 wicket bar around 03:45, shaking her confidence in her own innocence.
events.dramatic_function: Inquiry / Complication: the witness provides honest testimony that misidentifies the figure at the kiln.
beats: Maren questions Orson about exactly when the wicket was secured.
Orson states under oath that he saw Maren herself standing at the lock bar in her yellow oilskin coat at 03:45.
Maren realizes she cannot prove she was asleep at that hour and begins to doubt her own mind.

events.summary: Maren checks the maintenance shop for an extra key and spots fresh electrical arc burns on Bram's forearms.
events.dramatic_function: Inquiry / Plant: introduces physical evidence on the maintenance mechanic that connects to the high-voltage ignition line.
beats: Maren searches Bram's pegboard for duplicate wicket keys or master lock picks.
Bram aggressively orders her out, claiming he spent the shift rebuilding a slip pump.
Maren notices fresh, blistering arc burns across Bram's wrists and inner forearms.

events.summary: Arthur summons Maren to display her own grease-pencil initials on the 04:00 logbook entry.
events.dramatic_function: Inquiry / Complication: management displays seemingly irrefutable document evidence confirming Maren's actions.
beats: Arthur lays out the shift firing ledger on his desk.
Arthur shows the 04:00 gas valve check initialed with Maren's distinctive cursive mark.
Maren inspects the smudge and recognizes her hand, unable to comprehend when she could have drawn it.

events.summary: Maren catches Nora rewriting the gas manometer intake sheet to remove record of an overnight pressure collapse.
events.dramatic_function: Inquiry / Plant: plants the falsified gas ledger while proving that management is scrubbing records.
beats: Maren slips into the weighbridge booth to review the continuous pipeline manometer tapes.
Maren discovers Nora copying the numbers onto a sanitized sheet that omits a massive pressure plunge at 03:10.
Nora breaks down and whispers that Arthur ordered the gas drop erased from the permanent file.

events.summary: Tessa and Orson confront Maren on the floor, where Orson publicly repeats that he saw her seal Derry inside.
events.dramatic_function: Inquiry / Social Pressure: Maren is isolated from the floor workers, who now view her as an ambitious killer.
beats: Tessa convenes the shift workers near Kiln 4 to review safety protocols.
Orson openly declares to the crew that Maren stood at the padlock bar when Derry went missing.
Tessa tells Maren that the union must prioritize protecting the crew from manslaughter charges over saving her.

events.summary: Arthur brings the police liaison into Maren's office to conduct an aggressive formal search of her locker.
events.dramatic_function: Inquiry / Build-up: creates the stage where the planted evidence will be sprung upon Maren.
beats: Arthur demands Maren open her supervisor locker in full view of the yard committee.
Arthur announces that any concealed tools or unauthorized bypass keys will settle the matter.
Maren unlocks her steel locker, confident she has nothing illicit hidden inside.

events.summary: Arthur searches Maren's locker and pulls out Derry's soot-stained rag wrapped around the missing two-pound brass counterweight.
events.dramatic_function: Wrong Turn: the false case against Maren reaches its apex with physical proof apparently framing her for murder.
beats: Arthur pulls a soot-stained rag from beneath Maren's spare overalls.
The rag unrolls to reveal the missing two-pound brass counterweight from the batch scale.
Tessa turns away in disgust, abandoning Maren to management's custody.

events.summary: Arthur interrogates Maren in his office, constructing a damning narrative of exhausted rage that Maren nearly accepts.
events.dramatic_function: Wrong Turn: psychological rock bottom where the protagonist is nearly convinced of her own guilt.
beats: Arthur describes Maren striking Derry during an argument over shift speeds and locking him inside in panic.
Arthur points to the key, the initialed logbook, and the counterweight as total proof.
Maren, reeling from sleep deprivation, hovers on the verge of signing an admission of involuntary manslaughter.

events.summary: When Nora brings in the altered ledger, Maren notices the 03:10 gas drop proves the burners were unlit during Arthur's timeline.
events.dramatic_function: Wrong Turn Collapses: an internal contradiction in the manufactured story gives Maren the key to break it.
beats: Nora delivers the rewritten gas report for Arthur to sign before the detectives arrive.
Maren notes that if the gas failed at 03:10, Derry could not have burned during her 04:00 firing round.
Arthur stumbles over his explanation, inadvertently exposing that the firing timeline was fabricated.

events.summary: Maren pulls Orson back to the wicket and proves his identification of her in the steam was impossible.
events.dramatic_function: Wrong Turn / Pivot: dismantles the false witness testimony using factory acoustics and sightlines.
beats: Maren recreates the dense steam blowing from the slip agitators at 03:45.
Orson admits he only saw an oversized yellow oilskin coat and never saw the face of the person at the lock bar.
Orson mentions that the sleeves on the coat had heavy purple mending thread at the cuffs.

events.summary: Maren confronts Bram in the maintenance shop and reveals his coat has the purple twine cuffs Orson saw at the kiln.
events.dramatic_function: Solution: cracks the true sequence of physical events by identifying who was really at the wicket.
beats: Maren storms into the repair shop and seizes Bram's work slicker from the rack.
Maren matches the purple twine on the cuffs to the thread Orson observed at the lock bar.
Bram breaks down and confesses that he took Maren's master key while she slept at 03:30.

events.summary: Arthur attempts to silence Bram, but Maren proves Bram's arc burns match the muffle igniter line Derry was sent to patch.
events.dramatic_function: Solution: links the maintenance mechanic's injuries directly to management's clandestine repair operation.
beats: Arthur enters the bay and threatens to fire Bram on the spot if he speaks another word.
Maren forces Bram to expose his forearm burns, proving they match high-voltage burner electrodes.
Bram admits Arthur paid Derry fifty pounds to crawl into the hot muffle flue to weld a broken burner baffle.

events.summary: At the kiln base, Maren demonstrates that the propped roof damper was Derry's breathing line, which Arthur shut down early.
events.dramatic_function: Solution: the complete true account is assembled from all previously observed physical facts.
beats: Maren brings Tessa and Arthur to the rebar wedge holding the high roof damper open.
Maren explains the damper was Derry's only draft air while inside the flue crawlway.
Maren shows that Arthur engaged the automated firing cycle from the office, suffocating Derry and planting the weight to blame Maren.

events.summary: Port police arrive and arrest Arthur for corporate manslaughter, triggering an immediate shutdown of the factory.
events.dramatic_function: Cost: legal resolution arrives, but institutional collapse immediately follows.
beats: Maren hands the police the original manometer records and Bram's signed witness statement.
Arthur is handcuffed and led out, warning that exposing the plant will kill the town's livelihood.
The board of directors sends an emergency telegraph ordering the entire works locked out indefinitely.

events.summary: Maren leaves the padlocked factory as her former co-workers ostracize her for destroying the town's remaining jobs.
events.dramatic_function: Cost: the theme completes as the protagonist pays the full personal price for clearing her name.
beats: Receivers chain the factory gates shut, extinguishing the last operating kilns in the district.
Orson and the shift workers turn their backs in silence as Maren walks down the yard.
Tessa tells Maren that while she proved the truth, no works in the port will ever employ her again.

vacuous_checks: entry_exit_contradiction — entry_state is derived from the same replay that produces exit_state (src/segmentation/state.ts), so consecutive scenes agree by construction
plant_not_declared — every accepted plant/payoff pair writes its fact into the plant scene's own reader_must_learn as it is applied
unpaid_fact — reader_must_learn is populated only from facts that some scene pays off
